metaDescription: Order custom paraffin wax candles in bulk for your brand. Perfect for corporate gifts, events, and promotions. Get your quote today.
introHtml: Paraffin wax candles deliver a strong, consistent scent throw that fills a room quickly, making them a top choice for branded giveaways and corporate gifts. Unlike soy or beeswax, paraffin holds fragrance oils exceptionally well, so your logo on a custom paraffin wax candle will be associated with a long-lasting, noticeable aroma. Whether you are ordering for a trade show, client appreciation, or employee holiday gifts, paraffin candles offer reliable performance at a cost-effective price point. Choose from classic tins, tumblers, or decorative holders to match your brand aesthetic.
